ctx.x: I see. We didn't talk about Hawkins at all. Did you know him very well?

Oh boy, that was my man, Coleman Hawkins. Oh God, I can't say anything that hasn't already been said about Hawk. I made a lot of records with him, and sit around, been to his apartment so many times and sit down and talked and been around to different little joints with him. We'd go into. And just so many different things. Ride uptown together. Kirby, Hawk and I, we all used to sit around and discuss automobiles. They both liked the Chrysler and they were the ones made me buy a Chrysler at the time because I was…
